task: regression: pHC50 (= -log10(HC50 in M)) for a peptide; high pHC50 = hemolytic at low concentration = worse
architecture: sklearn Pipeline: SimpleImputer(strategy='median') + RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=800, max_depth=30, random_state=42)
description: Native Python reproduction of HemoPI2's regression model, trained on HemoPI2's own published cross-validation/test splits; no subprocess or vendored GPL code
features: 1167 hand-computed descriptors: MW, length, AAC, DPC, ATC, BTC, PCP, RRI, PRI, DDR, SER, SEP, CTC, CeTD, PAAC, APAAC, QSO, SOC (see predictor.py Extractor and property_tables.py)
target_transform: model predicts y = -log10(HC50 in uM); pHC50 = y_pred + 6.0
